svg.text: Every signal wire is 3.3 V. Only ONE wire carries 5 V: W1, which powers Nimue. Iolaus (LoRa) is powered from 3.3 V (W8), never 5 V.
Nimue makes its own 3.3 V inside.
((•)) talks to Argus by LoRa radio
3.3 V board: powered by W8 from
router TTGO LoRa32, stays by the router
Power only (its own USB or LiPo).
((•)) sends alerts to Iolaus by LoRa
No header wires, no external piezo.
Driven by the onboard codec and amp,
set up in the Merlin firmware.
Bottom-right corner, by the C6 module.
Wire list (Merlin pin numbers are J3 from Waveshare's schematic; pin 1 is the 5V end; the board prints GPIO numbers, not pin numbers)
W1 Nimue VBUS → Merlin 5V (pin 1 or 3), the only 5 V wire
W3 Nimue D7 (TX) → Merlin GPIO5 (pin 11), Merlin listens
W4 Merlin GPIO4 (pin 14) → Nimue D6 (RX), optional, dashed
W6 Iolaus GPIO13 (TX) → Merlin GPIO21 (pin 15), Merlin listens
⚠ 3.3 V on every signal pin. Never put Merlin's 5V on any GPIO of Nimue, Iolaus or Merlin.
Feed Nimue VBUS from Merlin 5V only with Nimue's USB unplugged. Feed Iolaus from Merlin 3V3 only with its USB and battery unplugged.
METER CHECK 1 (Merlin on USB, nothing else wired, black probe on GND): pins 1 and 3 read 5.0 V; pins 2 and 18 read 3.3 V; GPIO5, 21 and 22 read 0 V. If not, stop.
METER CHECK 2 (everything unplugged, meter on beep): each wire beeps end-to-end. Merlin 5V to GPIO5, GPIO21, GPIO22, 3V3 and Nimue 3V3 must NOT beep.
Camera (OV5647, Phase 3) uses Merlin's CAMERA ribbon socket, not header wires.
YOUR REAL WIRES: red = GND, teal/green = power (3V3 or VBUS). Diagram colours are only for reading the drawing.
